create_Act_with_relu: create an Act module with relu activation and apply it to a PyTorch tensor
create_Act_with_leaky_relu: create an Act module with leaky_relu activation and a custom slope value
create_Act_with_softplus: create an Act module with sp or ssp softplus activation for a neural network layer
create_Act_with_leaky_variants: create an Act module with leaky_sp, leaky_elu, leaky_ssp, or leaky_tanh activation
test_Act_forward: test the Act forward method with different activation types and input tensors
